__doc: Floors per model for the share of written findings the parse handles right on cases.json (run.js --gate), as ratios.

eval-fake (the wiring smoke, every PR): deterministic, since prose recovery returns a finding on no changed file and the rest replays recorded output. Two runs of main 4b5c881cd gave the same count on every case. floor = observed rounded down to 3 decimals, so a PR that loses one more finding fails.
Under it, main loses every finding in 10 of the 12 #2112 shapes that need no model call (shapes.js), which is why the value is low; the fix for #2112 raises it.

deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks (the nightly model; prose recovery is the only part that varies): calibrated 2026-10-15 from 2 local runs on 4b5c881cd, 377 and 369 of 830 (mean 44.9%). floor = mean - 2 binomial SE over the 830 findings, rounded down, like evals/reply-addressing/targets.json.

2026-10-16: a run end with no call and no text (3 of them) now counts as a check that nothing comes out. Recovery skips an empty end without a model call (looksLikeFindings, libs/code-review/infrastructure/agents/core/finder.agent.ts:442), so each passes on every model. eval-fake: two runs, 334 of 833 each. deepseek: the runs above become 380 and 372 of 833 (mean 45.1%); the floor stays.

2026-10-16, production's parse path (run state through the runner's eventToMessage/materializeArtifacts, recovery on the recorded run's slot, the generalist's mapFindings over the PR's files as the platform lists them): a model now replays only the runs recorded on it, since production recovers a run's prose on the slot it ended on. eval-fake replays all 168 cases and gave 334 of 833 on two runs, every item as before (old against new, item by item): the floor stands. deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks replays its own 19 cases (71 findings): two runs on 8b8eec46f plus this change, 33 and 33 of 71, every case equal in both (paired per-case difference 0). floor = mean - 2 binomial SE over the 71 findings, rounded down: 0.465 - 0.118 = 0.34. Deliberate break (extractFindings ignoring the submitResult artifact, local only): eval-fake 72 of 833, --gate exit 1.
RATCHET: a PR that moves the value on purpose (a parse fix, payloads recorded again, new labels) recalibrates here in the same PR, with its runs as evidence.

2026-10-20, #2112 (findings parse fix): a finding sent without existingCode is kept only with lines (else dropped, missing-location: it would land on the file's first hunk) and loses its fix (checkFix cannot see what it replaces), findings-schema.ts. So text-node-split expects its split finding dropped, and existing-code-missing checks no unchecked fix ships. main bd2cb7a22 under these shapes: 343 of 833 on two runs; only the 9 text-node-split cases differ from the old shapes (each +1). The fix: two runs, 783 of 833 each, every case equal in both and none below main. eval-fake floor = 0.9399 rounded down = 0.939. Deliberate breaks (local only): keeping the fix 0.894, keeping the unanchored finding 0.929, main's schema 0.525, each --gate exit 1. The 50 still missed are prose-only run ends (the scripted recovery returns a finding on no changed file). deepseek-v4-flash@fireworks, 2026-10-22, on bd2cb7a22 under these shapes: main 34 of 71 on two runs; the fix 71 of 71 on two runs, every case equal in both (paired per-case difference 0) and none below main. mean - 2 binomial SE is 1.0 at 71 of 71 (SE 0), so one miss would fail the gate; the floor is the Wilson 95% lower bound instead, 71 / (71 + 1.96^2) = 0.948, rounded down: 0.94. Finder recall on the same model and judge (evals/investigation, light set, 30 cases) does not move: main 32 of 95 bugs, the fix 32 and 31 of 95; its floor stands.

2026-10-22, #2112: seven more shapes from the issue and its design, each over the 9 models' base run end (the one the other shapes use, so the 168 earlier cases are unchanged; build-cases.js would pick a new base for minimax now that the fix parses more): payload-broken-json, bare-array, tool-call-wrapper, reason-alias, single-finding-flat, lines-as-strings, enum-unknown. Two runs per side on bd2cb7a22: main 437 of 1086, the fix 1036 of 1086, every case equal in both runs and none below main. bare-array and reason-alias already pass on main (controls). eval-fake floor = 0.9540 rounded down = 0.953. deepseek replays only its own recorded runs, so its floor (0.94) is unchanged.
